page_title: SHU 0-8 NEW | Sheffield Utd v Newcastle 24/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' John Egan (Sheffield Utd) has tested the patience of referee Stuart Attwell and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
87' 0 - 8 Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Wesley Foderingham with a strike into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:8.
83' The Newcastle players are exchanging some short passes.
82' Tom Davies (Sheffield Utd) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for a foul.
81' A substitution has been made. Bruno Guimaraes goes off and Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) comes on.
81' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
80' A dangerous towering header by Elliot Anderson (Newcastle Utd) from around the penalty spot goes just over the bar. This corner kick didn't change the score.
80' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
75' The game is interrupted. Anis Slimane (Sheffield Utd) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
75' We are about to witness a subsitution. Chris Basham (Sheffield Utd) for James McAtee.
73' 0 - 7 Goal! Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top right corner. It's 0:7.
70' Here is a change. Kieran Trippier is going off and Eddie Howe gives the last tactical orders to Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd).
70' Substitution. Callum Wilson did his best and is replaced by Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd).
70' Miguel Almiron will be replaced by Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd).
68' 0 - 6 Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom right corner.
66' Paul Heckingbottom has decided to substitute Gustavo Hamer and he is replaced by Anis Slimane (Sheffield Utd).
64' PENALTY APPEAL after Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Tom Davies (Sheffield Utd) is coming onto the pitch as Oliver Norwood cannot continue after picking up an injury.
61' 0 - 5 Goal! Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner.
60' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
59' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
59' Elliot Anderson (Newcastle Utd) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
56' 0 - 4 Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) leaps high to meet a deep cross and gives the goalkeeper no chance with a bullet header into the middle of the net.
54' Benie Traore (Sheffield Utd) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
52' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) makes a strong challenge and Stuart Attwell blows for a foul.
51' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
47' Anthony Gordon receives a sweet pass inside the box from Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd), but one of the defenders is first to the ball and makes an interception.
46' Paul Heckingbottom makes a half-time substitution. Benie Traore (Sheffield Utd) comes on in place of Jayden Bogle.
46' The second half has just started.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+6' A sweet pass finds Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the roof of the net. Wesley Foderingham is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. Now Newcastle have a corner.
45+2' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
45+1' Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
45' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle as Luke Thomas (Sheffield Utd) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
43' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

43' Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the left-hand post. Wesley Foderingham is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him. Newcastle force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
40' Luke Thomas (Sheffield Utd) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

39' Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Sheffield Utd.
39' Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) jumps into a tackle and Stuart Attwell signals a foul.
38' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Newcastle for a penalty. Play continues.

35' 0 - 3 The ball from the free kick finds its way to Sven Botman (Newcastle Utd) who finds himself some space and scores with a thunderous header into the bottom left corner. An incredible long-range header!
35' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
34' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jack Robinson (Sheffield Utd) was quite harsh and Stuart Attwell didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

34' Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Wesley Foderingham makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom right corner.

31' 0 - 2 Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Kieran Trippier. His header was precise and ended up inside the right post, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. The score is 0:2.
31' There's an opportunity for Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
30' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

30' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle have been awarded a corner kick.
28' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
28' Anel Ahmedhodzic (Sheffield Utd) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Stuart Attwell had an easy-decision to make.
27' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar.
27' Sheffield Utd failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
24' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd). Stuart Attwell saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
21' 0 - 1 Goal! A great through ball by Anthony Gordon sets up Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball into the top right corner. 0:1.

20' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Stuart Attwell blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.

18' Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the roof of the net, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save.
18' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
17' James McAtee (Sheffield Utd) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Stuart Attwell stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
16' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
14' A lofted pass finds Luke Thomas (Sheffield Utd) free in the box, but his first-time effort sails well wide of the left post.
13' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
12' Eddie Howe is forced to make a change. Harvey Barnes is unable to continue due to injury, Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) comes on.
10' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

8' The ball is laid off to Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the bottom left corner and forces Wesley Foderingham to make a decent save.
6' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd).
3' Luke Thomas (Sheffield Utd) makes a run into the box and gets on the end of a cross, but his well-taken shot crashes into a defender and is cleared away.
2' Referee Stuart Attwell sees the trip by Jack Robinson (Sheffield Utd) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Sheffield Utd will kick-off.
Stuart Attwell is introduced as the referee for today's match.
